name: LibriMix
description: A corpus for speech separation research, created by mixing utterances from LibriSpeech (and, in some configurations, WHAM!) to provide single- and multi-speaker mixture audio with source references.
citation: Cosentino, J., Pariente, M., Cornell, S., Kumar, A., Deleforge, A., & Vincent, E. (2020). LibriMix: An Open-Source Dataset for Generalizable Speech Separation. arXiv:2005.11262. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11262

license.notes: LibriMix does not provide a single standard SPDX license identifier for all distributed material. Mixtures inherit rights and terms from their source corpora (including LibriSpeech and optionally WHAM!); review each source corpus's license and applicable terms before use or redistribution.
